welcome.greeting: Hi, I'm Ada. Welcome to the office – take a seat and let's talk about AI.
welcome.clickableHint: Psst – the laptop and the old console are clickable too.

topics.menuTitle: What do you want to learn?

dialogue.continueHint: Click or press Space to continue

dungeon.title: The Dungeon
dungeon.soon: The dungeon gates are still locked. Come back soon to test what you've learned.

errors.genericBody: This part of the office hit a snag. Head back and keep learning.

tokensDemo.label: Type a sentence
tokensDemo.note: Each AI model splits text a little differently.

studio.copyFallback: Your prompt is selected below: press Ctrl+C to copy it.

output.empty: Press Build & test to see what the AI would write.
output.reading: The AI is reading your building…

builder.empty: Your building will appear here after Build & test.
builder.unavailable: The 3D builder isn't available here, so here's the plan view.
builder.planLabel: Plan view of your building, from the roof down

ada.name: Ada
ada.tipPrefix: It looks like you're writing a prompt!
ada.hole: There's a hole in the building: the {{label}} block is missing.
ada.sorry: Sorry, I missed it! I was looking for something like "{{example}}".
ada.bonus: Bonus points: your extra blocks reinforce the building.
ada.allDone: All six missions done! When you're ready, the old console in the office will test what you've learned.

prompts.empty: Your passed prompts will appear here. Finish a mission to save one.
prompts.confirm: Clear every saved prompt? Your passed missions stay ticked.

corrector.intro: Paste any prompt and I'll ask a real AI to inspect your building.
corrector.warning: Don't paste confidential client information or personal data: this text is sent to OpenAI.
corrector.checking: Asking the AI to inspect your building…
corrector.offlineHelp: It needs the workshop server with an OpenAI key. The missions still work without it.
corrector.builderEmpty: Your building will appear here after Check my prompt.
corrector.outputOffline: The corrector is offline, so there is nothing to compare yet.
corrector.copyFallback: The improved prompt is selected below. Press Ctrl+C to copy it.
corrector.ran: Both answers are ready, side by side.
corrector.stale: Edited since this check. Check your prompt again to update the report and run both.

errors.invalid: That prompt can't be checked. Check its length and try again.
errors.rate: You've reached the corrector's limit for now. Try again in a minute.
errors.timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.unavailable: The AI isn't reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.error: Something went wrong with the check. Try again.
